text.en: A car goes 20 m every second. The green line is 300 m away.
text.as: গাড়ীখনে প্ৰতি ছেকেণ্ডত 20 মিটাৰ যায়। সেউজীয়া ৰেখা 300 মিটাৰ দূৰত।

do.en: Slide time until the car reaches the line.

then.en: 20 × 15 = 300. Each second adds the same stretch, so distance is speed × time.
then.as: 20 × 15 = 300। প্ৰতি ছেকেণ্ডত একে দূৰত্ব যোগ হয়, সেয়ে দূৰত্ব = গতি × সময়।

text.en: 1 km/h means 1000 metres in 3600 seconds, and $\frac{1000}{3600} = \frac{5}{18}$.
A metre per second is the smaller-looking number, so 54 km/h becomes 15 m/s.
text.as: m/sৰ সংখ্যাটো সৰু, সেয়ে 54 km/h হয় 15 m/s।

q.as: 54 km/hক m/sলৈ সলনি কৰা।

learned.en: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time.
learned.as: গড় গতি = মুঠ দূৰত্ব ÷ মুঠ সময়।

learned.en: For equal distances at u and v, it is $\frac{2uv}{u + v}$.
learned.as: সমান দূৰত্ব u আৰু v গতিত: $\frac{2uv}{u + v}$।

learned.en: It is always closer to the slower speed.
Speed and time are inverse: $\frac{3}{4}$ speed means $\frac{4}{3}$ time.
learned.as: গতি আৰু সময় বিপৰীত: $\frac{3}{4}$ গতি মানে $\frac{4}{3}$ সময়।

text.en: Go 60 km at 30 km/h and return at 60 km/h. Width is time and height is speed. Find the level.

q.en: Walking at $3/4$ of his usual speed, a man is 10 minutes late. What is his usual time?

ask.en: The new time is what fraction of usual?

note.en: Time is the flip of speed.

ask.en: The delay is what fraction of usual?

text.en: A 300 m train at 20 m/s meets a pole. When has it passed? The red dot marks its tail.

do.en: Slide time until the tail clears the pole.

then.en: 15 seconds. The front was already there at the start, so the train had to cover its own 300 m.
then.as: 15 ছেকেণ্ড। আগফাল আৰম্ভণিতে আছিল, সেয়ে ৰেলে নিজৰ 300 মিটাৰ পাৰ হ'ব লাগিল।

text.en: Trains of 200 m and 100 m run towards each other at 20 and 10 m/s. The green bar is the distance to close.

do.en: Slide time until they have fully passed.

then.en: 300 m at a closing speed of 30 m/s takes 10 seconds. Only the closing speed matters.

q.en: A 200 m train at 15 m/s crosses a 100 m platform. Slide to the moment the tail clears.

why.en: The crossing ends when the tail clears, so the train's own length is part of the distance.
